events.details:
Join us for a park ranger-led program highlighting the nature and history of Jamaica Bay. For more information about a week's tour, call the Jamaica Bay Wildlife Refuge Visitor Center at 718-318-4340.

Saturday, 10/3: Junior Ranger Birding Buddies Join us on our Junior Ranger Birding Buddies' program, made for our Junior Rangers who are new to birding. We will learn the skills and tools used to have a fun outdoor adventure!   

Sunday, 10/4: Birding for Beginners Interested in birds, but feel intimidated about getting into birding? No problem, this is birding for beginners! Together we will take a nature walk, talk about what makes Jamaica Bay such a great place for birds, and give you the tools to learn the basics of bird identification and appreciation. Bug spray and sunscreen are recommended, binoculars available. 

Saturday, 10/10: Junior Ranger Walk: Bees and Butterflies of Jamaica Bay Bees and butterflies are a welcome summer sight in our gardens, yards, and parks! These little bugs are important pollinators who keep our environment in good working order. Join a ranger on a guided walk to learn all about the bees and butterflies that inhabit Jamaica Bay.

events.title: Gateway Collections Pop-Up at Fort Wadsworth
events.description: Gateway will host a Collections Pop-Up Event for members of the public to discover the diverse objects in the park's museum collection
events.details:
Gateway will host a Collections Pop-Up Event for members of the public to discover the diverse objects in the park's museum collection

Gateway National Recreation Area Cultural Resources will host a Collections Pop-Up Event for members of the public to discover the rich and diverse objects in the park’s museum collection on Saturday, October 24 from 1:00-3:00 pm. Visit with Seasonal Museum Techs Jade Maynard and Sarah McCullough who will spotlight a few of their favorite items from our vast collections. Gateway's museum collections include items such as architectural drawings, photographs, military manuals, architectural elements, uniforms, and much more, spanning from approximately 2,700 BCE into the twentieth century. Some of the artifacts that will be on display are from the American Revolutionary Period, in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence.

This event will be hosted at the Fort Wadsworth Visitor Center in the Staten Island Unit at 120 New York Avenue. events.details:
Join us on Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th to celebrate Theodore Roosevelt’s 168th birthday! If you come to the Birthplace dressed as TR on either day, you will receive a small “birthday present” to take home! There will also be free crafts, a photo op station, and a children’s storytime held at 10:15 AM and 1:00 PM on both days!  

 Theodore Roosevelt Bithplace is at 28 East 20th Street, New York, NY 10003. The site is open from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Free first-come, first-served house tours are available at 11:00, 12:00, 2:00, and 3:00. Space for these tours is limited. Questions? Please email thrb_info@nps.gov or visit www.nps.gov/thrb.
